request.text: I've finished drafting the abstract here in the quiet library. Give me one blink as a break cue—no second blink when you follow up—and then say the cue is done.

responsibilities.outcome: Give exactly one blink as the user's quiet-library break cue.
After the cue, tell the user it is complete without producing another blink.

new_goals.description: Give one quiet blink as the user's break cue and then confirm completion without duplicating the action during re-entry.
new_goals.source_text: I've finished drafting the abstract here in the quiet library. Give me one blink as a break cue—no second blink when you follow up—and then say the cue is done.
constraints: Keep the embodied cue to one blink.
Treat trusted terminal evidence as completion and use speech, not another Capability call, for the follow-up.
success_criteria: The break cue is completed once and followed by a concise verbal acknowledgement with no replay.

semantic_facts: The terminal evidence should advance the existing Goal to a short spoken acknowledgement that the quiet break cue completed.
The user's statement supports acknowledging that they finished drafting the abstract, but the evidence does not support judging its quality or completeness.
forbidden_claims: The planner performs a second blink while handling the capability-result re-entry.
The assistant claims to have reviewed, approved, or assessed the abstract.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner mistakes the follow-up phase for a fresh action phase and duplicates a terminal embodied cue.
A user-reported drafting milestone is inflated into an unsupported assessment of the work product.
